description: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.

written.description: Checks an agent skill before you install it, following the files it pulls in and asking a model whether any of it is trying to misdirect the agent. Each verdict carries the provenance behind it.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(providers): reject SKILLSPECTOR_TEMPERATURE for all Claude models that drop sampling (#964)

* fix(providers): reject SKILLSPECTOR_TEMPERATURE for all Claude models that drop sampling

Anthropic's migration guides state that Claude Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5.1 and Haiku 5.5 answer requests carrying temperature, top_p or top_k with HTTP 400, and that Opus 4.7 and 4.8 already do. SAMPLING_REJECTED_MODELS listed only claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5, so on the other models the guard did not fire and users got the raw 400 instead of the clear 'not supported' error.

Cover the opus-4-7/4-8, opus-5, sonnet-5, fable-5 and haiku-5 families (snapshots and point releases included), update the tests that assumed fable-5-1 accepted temperature, and update the docs.
